TARGET PANEL (See Sketch “A”) With gears off and chain not engaged with motor sprocket, position sinking ship carriage in center of panel (12-5/8 from inside of frame). Assemble chain as shown in sketch around motor, gear drive and idler sprockets. Adjust chain tension per sketch at right idler. Attach 90 tooth gear to long crank shaft and tighten set screw on shaft flat. Note, when assembling all gears, be sure they are positioned against the shoulder of the shaft. With the long crank positioned vertically down, engage the 12 tooth drive pinion with the 90 tooth gear. Before engaging, rotate the pinion until one of it’s set screws is perpendicular to the flat on shaft. Tighten both set screws securely. With the short crank vertically down, engage the 48 tooth gear and tighten set screws. The assembly should now look like the sketch with both cranks vertically down and the sinking ship carriage in the center of panel. Caution: This adjustment must be exactly like the sketch or else the links and levers will interfere causing machine damage. The two ends of stroke roller leaf switches must be adjusted for 17” carriage travel. Caution: Do not try to move the carriage, links or gears manually. Only use the motor (12 V.D.C.).
